logging.log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

logging.log_file.description: Name of the main log file.

logging.format.description: Log message format (Python logging format string).

debug.description: Enable debug-level logging for verbose troubleshooting.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (more detailed than INFO).

messaging.transport_url.description: RabbitMQ or other message bus transport URL for event/metric transport.

keystone_auth.password.description: Keystone user password for authentication to OpenStack services.

keystone_auth.username.description: Keystone username used by the Ceilometer IPMI agent.

keystone_auth.project_name.description: Keystone project (tenant) name for the Ceilometer service account.

keystone_auth.user_domain_name.description: Keystone domain name for the user.

keystone_auth.project_domain_name.description: Keystone domain name for the project.

keystone_auth.cacert.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for SSL verification (optional).

keystone_auth.insecure.description: Disable SSL certificate verification (not recommended in production).

keystone_auth.ssl_verify.description: Enable SSL/TLS verification for Keystone connections.

ipmi.driver.description: IPMI driver library to use (e.g., pyghmi.ipmi, freeipmi).

ipmi.polling_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between IPMI polling cycles.

ipmi.max_concurrent_polls.description: Maximum number of BMCs that can be polled simultaneously.

ipmi.bmcs.description: List of IPMI Baseboard Management Controllers (BMCs) to monitor.

address.description: IP address or hostname of the BMC.

name.description: Descriptive name for this BMC (used in comments).

ipmi.metrics.description: List of IPMI metrics to collect (e.g., power, temperature, fan, voltage).

name.description: Name of the metric to enable (must be supported by the IPMI driver).

interval.description: Override polling interval for this specific metric (in seconds). Optional.

ipmi.hostnames.description: Optional mapping between BMC IP addresses and OpenStack compute node hostnames.

compute_hostname.description: Corresponding OpenStack compute node hostname (nova hostname).

ipmi.retry_attempts.description: Number of retry attempts for failed IPMI commands.

ipmi.retry_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) between IPMI retry attempts.

ipmi.timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for each IPMI command.

notification.topics.description: List of topics to publish Ceilometer messages to.

pipeline.config_file.description: Path to the pipeline configuration file.

events.definitions_file.description: Path to the event definitions file for Ceilometer events.

metric_source.description: Source of metric data. For this agent, must be 'ipmi'.
